title: Kafka Stack Command Center
description: The whole Kafka stack on one screen: resources, pipeline flow, connectors and tasks, auto-recovery, lag, latency, backpressure and alerts

panels.description: Healthy only when the broker is up with one active controller and no offline or under-min-ISR partitions, the Connect worker is up, no connector is DEGRADED or FAILED, and every Debezium engine is connected to its database. Platform-wide (ignores the Connector filter).

targets.expr: (((clamp_max(max(kafka_brokers), 1)) or on() vector(0)) * ((sum(kafka_controller_kafkacontroller_activecontrollercount) == bool 1) or on() vector(0)) * (((sum(kafka_controller_kafkacontroller_offlinepartitionscount) or on() vector(0)) == bool 0) or on() vector(0)) * (((sum(kafka_server_replicamanager_underminisrpartitioncount) or on() vector(0)) == bool 0) or on() vector(0)) * ((clamp_max(max(up{job="connect-jmx"}), 1)) or on() vector(0)) * (((count(((max by (connector) (kafka_connect_connector_status{connector=~".+",status=~"failed"}) * 3) or (max by (connector) (kafka_connect_connector_status{connector=~".+",status=~"paused|stopped"}) * 1) or (max by (connector) (kafka_connect_connector_status{connector=~".+",status=~"unassigned|restarting"}) * 2) or (max by (connector) (kafka_connect_connector_status{connector=~".+",status=~"running"}) * 2 * clamp_max((sum by (connector) (kafka_connect_worker_connector_failed_task_count{connector=~".+"}) > bool 0) + (sum by (connector) (kafka_connect_worker_connector_running_task_count{connector=~".+"}) < bool sum by (connector) (kafka_connect_worker_connector_total_task_count{connector=~".+"})), 1)) or (max by (connector) (kafka_connect_connector_status{connector=~".+",status=~"running"}) * 0)) >= 2) or on() vector(0)) == bool 0) or on() vector(0)) * (((count(max by (name) (debezium_metrics_connected{context="streaming",name=~".+"}) == 0) or on() vector(0)) == bool 0) or on() vector(0)))

0.text: ✖  Attention Needed   |   a broker, connector, task or capture engine is down or degraded: see the walls below

1.text: ✔  All Systems Healthy   |   Kafka, Kafka Connect and every Debezium connector are running normally

panels.title: Host CPU
panels.description: All cores of the host, busy share over 5 minutes

panels.title: Host RAM
panels.description: Memory in use, not counting the page cache (which the kernel frees on demand and Kafka uses to serve reads)

panels.title: Data disk
panels.description: Filesystem holding the Docker volumes (Kafka logs). Kafka stops when it is full: act at 75%.

panels.title: Kafka heap
panels.description: Broker JVM heap used of max (1 GB). Messages are in the page cache, not here.

panels.title: Connect heap
panels.description: Kafka Connect + Debezium heap used of max. Debezium buffers open Oracle transactions here; a sawtooth up to 80% is normal G1 behaviour.

panels.title: Container memory (used of limit)
panels.description: Working set of each stack container as a share of its mem_limit in docker-compose.yml. At 100% the container is killed (OOM).

defaults.noValue: No container names (cAdvisor on Docker Desktop)

panels.description: Change events Debezium read from the source databases (all engines)

targets.expr: (sum(rate(debezium_metrics_totalnumberofeventsseen{context="streaming",name=~".+"}[5m])) or on() vector(0)) or on() vector(-1)
(sum(increase(debezium_metrics_totalnumberofeventsseen{context="streaming",name=~".+"}[1h])) or on() vector(0)) or on() vector(-1)

panels.description: Records the source connectors wrote to Kafka, and all messages produced to the broker by any client

targets.expr: (sum(rate(kafka_connect_source_task_source_record_write_total[5m])) or on() vector(0)) or on() vector(-1)

panels.description: Messages in Kafka that consumer groups have not processed yet (total consumer lag)

targets.expr: (sum(clamp_min(kafka_consumergroup_lag, 0)) or on() vector(0)) or on() vector(-1)
(count(sum by (consumergroup) (clamp_min(kafka_consumergroup_lag{consumergroup=~".+"}, 0)) > 1000) or on() vector(0)) or on() vector(-1)

panels.description: Messages processed (offsets committed) by all consumer groups

targets.expr: (sum(sum by (consumergroup) (rate(kafka_consumergroup_current_offset{consumergroup=~".+"}[5m]))) or on() vector(0)) or on() vector(-1)
(count(max by (consumergroup) (kafka_consumergroup_members{consumergroup=~".+"}) > 0) or on() vector(0)) or on() vector(-1)

panels.description: MilliSecondsBehindSource of the slowest Debezium engine. IDLE: no change captured since the engine started.
Lag / consume rate of the worst consumer group. STALLED: messages are waiting and the group consumes nothing.

targets.expr: (max(sum by (consumergroup) (clamp_min(kafka_consumergroup_lag{consumergroup=~".+"}, 0)) / (sum by (consumergroup) (rate(kafka_consumergroup_current_offset{consumergroup=~".+"}[5m])) > 0)) or (max(sum by (consumergroup) (clamp_min(kafka_consumergroup_lag{consumergroup=~".+"}, 0)) > 0) * 0 - 2) or on() vector(0)) or on() vector(-1)

text.fixed: worst consumer group at its current rate

panels.title: Connectors
panels.description: OK, PAUSED (paused or stopped on purpose), DEGRADED (running with a failed or missing task) or FAILED. A connector can be RUNNING while all its tasks have FAILED: this wall shows that as DEGRADED.

targets.expr: (max by (connector) (kafka_connect_connector_status{connector=~"$connector",status=~"failed"}) * 3) or (max by (connector) (kafka_connect_connector_status{connector=~"$connector",status=~"paused|stopped"}) * 1) or (max by (connector) (kafka_connect_connector_status{connector=~"$connector",status=~"unassigned|restarting"}) * 2) or (max by (connector) (kafka_connect_connector_status{connector=~"$connector",status=~"running"}) * 2 * clamp_max((sum by (connector) (kafka_connect_worker_connector_failed_task_count{connector=~"$connector"}) > bool 0) + (sum by (connector) (kafka_connect_worker_connector_running_task_count{connector=~"$connector"}) < bool sum by (connector) (kafka_connect_worker_connector_total_task_count{connector=~"$connector"})), 1)) or (max by (connector) (kafka_connect_connector_status{connector=~"$connector",status=~"running"}) * 0)

panels.title: Tasks
panels.description: Every task of every connector. Tasks do the actual work: a FAILED task captures nothing.

targets.expr: (max by (connector, task) (kafka_connect_connector_task_status{connector=~"$connector",status=~"running"}) * 0) or (max by (connector, task) (kafka_connect_connector_task_status{connector=~"$connector",status=~"paused|stopped"}) * 1) or (max by (connector, task) (kafka_connect_connector_task_status{connector=~"$connector",status=~"unassigned|restarting"}) * 2) or (max by (connector, task) (kafka_connect_connector_task_status{connector=~"$connector",status=~"failed"}) * 3)

panels.title: Auto-recovery (24 h)
panels.description: What connect-guardian did: restarts of failed and stalled tasks, and offset resets of connectors whose source position was lost (for example purged archive logs).

targets.expr: (sum(increase(connect_guardian_actions_total{action="restart"}[24h])) or on() vector(0)) or on() vector(-1)
(sum(increase(connect_guardian_actions_total{action="restart_stalled"}[24h])) or on() vector(0)) or on() vector(-1)
(sum(increase(connect_guardian_actions_total{action="reset"}[24h])) or on() vector(0)) or on() vector(-1)

panels.title: Connector details
panels.description: One row per connector. Auto-recovery is connect-guardian's view: WATCHING (healthy), RECOVERING (restarting with backoff, or just reset), NEEDS A PERSON (permanent error such as a bad password or missing privilege), PARKED (paused or stopped by an operator).

targets.expr: (max by (connector) (kafka_connect_connector_status{connector=~"$connector",status=~"failed"}) * 3) or (max by (connector) (kafka_connect_connector_status{connector=~"$connector",status=~"paused|stopped"}) * 1) or (max by (connector) (kafka_connect_connector_status{connector=~"$connector",status=~"unassigned|restarting"}) * 2) or (max by (connector) (kafka_connect_connector_status{connector=~"$connector",status=~"running"}) * 2 * clamp_max((sum by (connector) (kafka_connect_worker_connector_failed_task_count{connector=~"$connector"}) > bool 0) + (sum by (connector) (kafka_connect_worker_connector_running_task_count{connector=~"$connector"}) < bool sum by (connector) (kafka_connect_worker_connector_total_task_count{connector=~"$connector"})), 1)) or (max by (connector) (kafka_connect_connector_status{connector=~"$connector",status=~"running"}) * 0)

(max by (connector) (kafka_connect_connector_status{connector=~"$connector",status=~"running"}) * 0) or (max by (connector) (kafka_connect_connector_status{connector=~"$connector",status=~"paused"}) * 1) or (max by (connector) (kafka_connect_connector_status{connector=~"$connector",status=~"stopped"}) * 2) or (max by (connector) (kafka_connect_connector_status{connector=~"$connector",status=~"unassigned"}) * 3) or (max by (connector) (kafka_connect_connector_status{connector=~"$connector",status=~"restarting"}) * 4) or (max by (connector) (kafka_connect_connector_status{connector=~"$connector",status=~"failed"}) * 5) or (max by (connector) (kafka_connect_connector_status{connector=~"$connector",status=~"destroyed"}) * 6)

panels.title: Pipeline flow (/s)
panels.description: The three stages should move together. Written but not consumed: consumers are behind. Captured high but written low: Kafka or the Connect producer is the bottleneck.

panels.title: Waiting in queue by consumer group (msgs)
CDC latency by engine (s)
panels.description: Seconds between a commit in the source database and Debezium processing it. Dashed lines at 10 s and 30 s.

panels.title: Backpressure: Debezium queue used (%)
panels.description: Debezium's buffer between the database reader and Kafka. Near 100%: Kafka cannot take records as fast as they are captured, and capture slows down.

targets.expr: (sum(kafka_controller_kafkacontroller_offlinepartitionscount) or on() vector(0)) or on() vector(-1)
(sum(kafka_server_replicamanager_underminisrpartitioncount) or on() vector(0)) or on() vector(-1)

defaults.noValue: No alerts in the last 24 hours

ConnectorOffsetsReset.text: Connector lost its position and was reset

ConnectorCaptureStalled.text: Connector capture stalled and was restarted
